title: Adopt the shared wiki contract: repo-local surfaces, retrieval, and dispatch readiness
summary: Tracker for the IN-0001 adoption readiness review. Root AGENTS.md may not exist yet in a freshly bootstrapped repo. The findings-only adoption-verify review slice runs the structured `wiki adoption verify` command, which exercises the five required read-only readiness checks and confirms repo-local AGENTS.md guidance, operator-supplied first-run launcher setup, the bootstrap-generated wiki/.wiki-mcp.json declaration, and the bootstrap-seeded docs/adoption.md as readiness context. Bootstrap seeds this work, generates the gitignored wiki/.wiki-mcp.json declaration, and seeds docs/adoption.md from a package template (create-if-missing, so a customized doc is preserved on rerun); package/bootstrap first-run guidance leaves root AGENTS.md authoring as the primary adoption deliverable — the orchestrator drives it to completion by dispatching the seeded worker-owned implementation slice `WK-0001#SLICE-001` (write_scope ["AGENTS.md"]), never by writing the repo root directly and never by skipping it — while agent-launch.toml copy/init-config remains a launcher prerequisite to satisfy before orchestrator dispatch.
scope: Bring the consuming repo up to the shared wiki/agent contract with one findings-only adoption-verify review that confirms agent-launch.toml exists and is suitable and reports root AGENTS.md presence as advisory context, along with the wiki-retrieval, work-record, read-only graph-impact, generate/lint, dispatch/preflight, and operator first-run launcher setup readiness checks (plus the non-gating AGENTS.md, wiki-mcp-alias, and docs/adoption.md informational entries). First-run loop: run `npx wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json` (or package-qualified `npx -p @agent-chassis/wiki-cli wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json`); if blocked on operator-owned launcher prerequisites (missing or invalid `agent-launch.toml` role defaults or `.agent-launch` init-config), report them and ask the operator to run `npx agent-chassis setup`, then rerun adoption verify; authoring root `AGENTS.md` is the primary adoption deliverable. Because bootstrap never creates it, the orchestrator must set it up by dispatching the seeded worker-owned implementation slice `WK-0001#SLICE-001` (write_scope ["AGENTS.md"]) through the structured MCP dispatch route — it must not write root `AGENTS.md` directly (orchestrator write scope does not include the repo root) and must not skip authoring it or treat it as optional. That worker derives the repo-specific content from `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md`, replaces placeholders, and removes unsupported tool and canonical-layer claims so the result is repo-specific operating guidance and not a blind copy (the boilerplate is a helper template, not current-session operating authority). A transiently-missing root `AGENTS.md` does not by itself flip the adoption-verify readiness verdict to blocked, but that never makes authoring it optional. Dispatch implementation only through scoped `WK-*` slices; proceed once required checks pass. Bootstrap generates the gitignored wiki/.wiki-mcp.json local metadata and seeds docs/adoption.md from a package template (create-if-missing) on each run; reviewing those surfaces is part of the adoption-verify readiness check, not a separate worker-owned implementation slice.
out_of_scope: Do not modify the shared agent-chassis packages, do not edit global MCP client config, do not have the orchestrator write root AGENTS.md directly (dispatch the seeded worker-owned slice `WK-0001#SLICE-001` with write_scope ["AGENTS.md"] via the structured MCP dispatch route instead), do not launch the seeded orchestrator while adoption verify reports missing or invalid launcher config (a missing root AGENTS.md alone is advisory and does not block), do not assign a worker to edit or recreate the bootstrap-generated wiki/.wiki-mcp.json (bootstrap owns it as gitignored local metadata), do not assign a worker to author docs/adoption.md from scratch (bootstrap seeds it from a package template; only optional repo-specific customization remains), do not assign a worker to author agent-launch.toml (package/bootstrap first-run guidance supplies the operator copy/init-config step), and note that bootstrap seeding alone does not make the repo agent-operable.

criteria: The adoption-verify review slice is completed or carries an explicit recorded blocker.

Root AGENTS.md is authored/adapted as the primary adoption deliverable via the seeded worker-owned implementation slice `WK-0001#SLICE-001` (write_scope ["AGENTS.md"]), dispatched through the structured MCP dispatch route (never written directly by the orchestrator); the result is repo-adapted rather than a bootstrap-generated placeholder. It may be absent immediately after bootstrap, and a transiently-missing root AGENTS.md does not by itself flip the adoption-verify verdict to blocked, but authoring it remains required adoption work, not optional.

The seed tells the agent/operator to run `npx agent-chassis setup`, review/adapt `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md` into root `AGENTS.md`, rerun `npx wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json`, and proceed only after required checks pass.

agent-launch.toml exists as operator-supplied first-run launcher config with explicit model defaults for orchestrator, worker, reviewer, and redteam; the bootstrap-seeded docs/adoption.md and the bootstrap-generated wiki/.wiki-mcp.json are confirmed by the adoption-verify review (docs/adoption.md present and valid; wiki/.wiki-mcp.json schema wiki-mcp-workspace.v1, a resolved current.root, and a repo-derived current.alias), not authored or edited by bootstrap.

`npx -p @agent-chassis/wiki-cli wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json` reports verdict "ready" (all five required checks pass) or records a specific structured blocker per non-pass check; the repo is not claimed agent-operable unless the verdict is ready.

slices.title: Create repo-local AGENTS.md
slices.summary: Author the consuming repo's root AGENTS.md by adapting the seeded boilerplate helper into repo-specific operating guidance. This is the primary adoption deliverable; the orchestrator dispatches this worker slice through the structured MCP dispatch route and never writes the repo root directly.
slices.scope: Create root `AGENTS.md` by deriving it from `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md`: replace the `[repo-name]` placeholder, adapt each section to this repo's real structured tools, retrieval surfaces, and canonical layers, and remove or qualify any boilerplate section describing a tool, MCP capability, or canonical layer this repo has not adopted. The authored file must be repo-specific operating authority, not a blind copy of the helper. The write happens only within this worker slice's write_scope (`AGENTS.md`); the orchestrator must not write the repo root directly.
slices.out_of_scope: Do not copy the boilerplate verbatim, do not leave the `[repo-name]` placeholder or any other bracketed placeholder, do not claim unsupported tools/MCP/code-index capabilities or canonical layers, and do not edit shared agent-chassis package source or any file outside `AGENTS.md`.

criteria: Root `AGENTS.md` exists at the repo root, derived from `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md` and adapted to this repo rather than copied verbatim.
No `[repo-name]` placeholder or any other bracketed placeholder remains in the authored `AGENTS.md`.

Unsupported tool, MCP, and canonical-layer claims carried by the boilerplate are removed or qualified, so every structured tool, MCP capability, and canonical layer named in `AGENTS.md` is actually supported by this repo.
`AGENTS.md` reads as repo-specific operating authority, not a blind copy of the helper template.

slices.title: Verify first-run adoption readiness
slices.summary: Findings-only review that runs the structured adoption verification command and confirms the five required read-only readiness checks before treating the repo as agent-operable.
slices.scope: Run `npx wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json` from the repo's own context (or package-qualified `npx -p @agent-chassis/wiki-cli wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json`; `npm run wiki -- adoption verify --json` is shorthand only if this repo defines a wiki npm script) and confirm the five required read-only checks report pass: wiki-retrieval, work-records, generate-lint, graph-impact, and dispatch-preflight. If dispatch-preflight reports missing or invalid launcher config (`operator_first_run_prerequisites_missing` naming `agent-launch.toml` role defaults or `.agent-launch` init-config), report the operator-owned prerequisite, ask the operator to run `npx agent-chassis setup`, rerun adoption verify, and hold orchestrator launch until required checks pass. A missing root `AGENTS.md` is reported as non-gating advisory context — recommend reviewing/adapting `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md` into root `AGENTS.md`, but it does not block on its own. Also confirm the non-gating AGENTS.md informational entry (a present root AGENTS.md is repo-adapted rather than a blind boilerplate copy), the wiki-mcp-alias, and docs/adoption.md informational entries, and that operator first-run launcher setup has supplied agent-launch.toml/init-config readiness. This is a findings-only review unit, so an empty write_scope is valid; this slice does not edit repo files or package source.
slices.out_of_scope: Findings-only: do not modify repo files, do not edit the bootstrap-generated wiki/.wiki-mcp.json, do not persist graph evidence to a work record, do not launch a real worker, and do not claim the repo is agent-operable unless the verify verdict is ready.

criteria: `npx -p @agent-chassis/wiki-cli wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json` runs and reports all five required checks by name: wiki-retrieval, work-records, generate-lint, graph-impact, and dispatch-preflight.

The work-records check fails with a structured blocker when WK-0001 cannot be loaded or validated, so a bare bootstrapped repo is not reported ready until the adoption tracker itself is valid; the adoption-verify review slice itself may remain open while the review runs.

The non-gating wiki-mcp-alias informational entry confirms the bootstrap-generated wiki/.wiki-mcp.json exists, carries schema wiki-mcp-workspace.v1, current.root resolves to the repo root, and current.alias is repo-derived unless a deliberate operator alias was chosen; this entry never flips the ready verdict on its own.

The non-gating docs/adoption.md informational entry confirms the bootstrap-seeded operator guide exists and is valid (Markdown with a top-level heading); docs/adoption.md is bootstrap-generated, not a worker-authored implementation slice, and this entry never flips the ready verdict on its own.
The graph-impact check is read-only: it persists no graph evidence to a work record and the envelope reports persisted_evidence false.

Verdict is "ready" (all five required checks pass) or a specific structured blocker is recorded for each non-pass check; the repo is not claimed agent-operable unless the verdict is ready, and a missing or invalid launcher config (`operator_first_run_prerequisites_missing`) keeps the dispatch-preflight check blocked until the operator completes setup and verify is rerun, while a missing root AGENTS.md is advisory and does not block on its own.
